channel.title: The Grant Desk - Artist Residencies, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Artist Residencies, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Mabou Mines SUITE/space Residency 2027-2029 (NYC early-career interdisciplinary performance, two USD 4,000 stipends) (closes 22 Nov)
item.description:
Mabou Mines
Deadline: 22 Nov 2026, 23:59 EST
Award: Two USD 4,000 stipends (dependent on funding), plus 100 hours of rehearsal space and technical support. No application fee.

SUITE/space is Mabou Mines' two-year performance residency for early-career interdisciplinary artists in New York whose practices come from lived experiences at the margins. WHO: NYC-based early-career interdisciplinary performance artists.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: University of Notre Dame: Love Ethic Social Innovator Fellowships 2028 (residency plus USD 15,000 and up to USD 50,000 project funding) (closes 11 Dec)
item.description:
University of Notre Dame, Institute for Ethics and the Common Good
Deadline: 11 Dec 2026
Award: Stipend for housing during the residency plus relocation support; USD 15,000 to the fellow's organisation to offset the four-week sabbatical; up to USD 50,000 in subgrant funding after the residency to pilot the proposed project; travel to all programme gatherings covered. No application fee.

Up to six short-term fellowships for practitioners outside academia (nonprofit leaders, community organisers, social workers, faith leaders, entrepreneurs, public-sector professionals) who want time and space to design a new initiative grounded in love-based ethics.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Craigardan Trillium Fellowship 2027 (residency for artists, activists and scholars of color, USD 4,600 + USD 500 honorarium) (closes 15 Dec)
item.description:
Craigardan
Deadline: 15 Dec 2026
Award: USD 4,600 fellowship toward a minimum two-week residency (covers the residency fee), plus a USD 500 honorarium. Travel, materials and personal expenses are not covered. USD 25 application fee (waivers available on request).

The Trillium Fellowship supports artists, activists and scholars of color working in any discipline who would benefit from the time and space to pursue their work or find creative retreat at Craigardan, a residency and farm in the Adirondacks.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Smartwear Revolution Artist-in-Residence 2027 (University of Alberta): In-Person and Virtual Residencies (closes 15 Dec)
item.description:
Co-Designing a Smartwear Revolution, University of Alberta (Art & Design Working Group), funded by the New Frontiers in Research Fund
Deadline: 15 Dec 2026
Award: In-person: CAD 12,000 covering artist fee, materials, travel, accommodation and production. Virtual: CAD 8,000 covering materials and production. Stage-2 interviewees receive a CAD 100 honorarium. No application fee.

Two artist residencies with Co-Designing a Smartwear Revolution, a University of Alberta research network of 100+ researchers in textile science, AI and robotics building smart garments with sensors and actuators.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Planetary Transitions 2027: Potsdam Artist Residency (EUR 2,500/month, 4 to 6 months at a sustainability research institute) (closes 7 Feb 2027)
item.description:
Research Institute for Sustainability (RIFS) at GFZ, with the City of Potsdam and the DAAD Artists-in-Berlin Program
Deadline: 7 Feb 2027
Award: Monthly stipend of EUR 2,500, plus a lump sum for travel to Potsdam and back, and up to EUR 5,000 housing support if you stay in Potsdam. No application fee stated.

An art-science residency that brings an international artist into the Research Institute for Sustainability (RIFS) in Potsdam to work alongside researchers on sustainability and planetary transitions. Run since 2025 by RIFS at GFZ, the City of Potsdam and the DAAD Artists-in-Berlin Program.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Saari Residence 2028 (Kone Foundation, Finland; monthly grant plus housing and workspace) (closes 31 Mar 2027)
item.description:
Kone Foundation, Saari Residence
Deadline: 31 Mar 2027, 16:00 EEST
Award: Monthly grant for living, travel and other costs, plus accommodation and workspace. The 2028 figure is not yet published; the 2027 cycle paid EUR 2,700, 3,200 or 3,800 per month depending on career stage. No application fee.

Saari Residence is the Kone Foundation's residency in rural southwest Finland, applied for a year in advance. Residents get housing, a workspace and a monthly grant (EUR 2,700 to 3,800 per month in the 2027 cycle, depending on career stage; 2028 figures not yet published).

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Schloss Wiepersdorf Individual and Collaborative Fellowships 2028 (Brandenburg; EUR 1,200/month plus room and board) (closes 15 Apr 2027)
item.description:
Schloss Wiepersdorf (state of Brandenburg)
Deadline: 15 Apr 2027, 23:59 CEST
Award: EUR 1,200 per month stipend, a one-time EUR 480 material grant, room and board, and German visa costs where needed. No application fee.

Three-month residential fellowships at Schloss Wiepersdorf for artists, writers, composers and scholars from Germany and abroad. Fellows get room, board, a EUR 1,200 monthly stipend and a material grant; fine artists get a studio where space allows.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Democracy Foundation: Democracy Residency 'European Dream' 2027 (Kuldiga, Latvia; Liepaja European Capital of Culture) (closes 15 Nov)
item.description:
Democracy Foundation (Kuldiga), part of the Liepaja 2027 European Capital of Culture programme
Deadline: 15 Nov 2026
Award: EUR 1,000 stipend per participant (covering expenses during the residency, including travel), plus up to EUR 1,000 per participant to develop and run their activity, and accommodation in Kuldiga's Old Town. Six participants. No application fee stated.

International interdisciplinary residency run by the Democracy Foundation in Kuldiga, Latvia, as part of the Liepaja 2027 European Capital of Culture programme.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Futures of Listening x Immersive Audio Network: Residency Open Call (Bristol, IAN Festival 2027) (closes 21 Nov)
item.description:
Futures of Listening (FIBER, 4DSOUND, Robin Koek, Art of Sound) and the Immersive Audio Network (IAN)
Deadline: 21 Nov 2026, 23:59 CET
Award: EUR 1,750 residency fee (excl. VAT, paid on invoice), plus return travel from the Netherlands to Bristol and private accommodation for 22 to 30 January 2027. No application fee.

One residency for a freelance audio practitioner (composer, sound designer, audio maker, artist or researcher) registered in the Netherlands, to develop an existing project into a spatial, story-led sound work.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: MON-ART: Nicosia Monastery of Arts Residency 2027, art, sustainability and community (Cyprus, EUR 6,000 fee) (closes 23 Nov)
item.description:
Visual Voices (MON-ART project, co-funded by Creative Europe)
Deadline: 23 Nov 2026
Award: EUR 6,000 artist fee per artist, plus EUR 1,400 production costs, travel (EUR 600-1,000) and shared accommodation. Two artists selected. No application fee stated.

Visual Voices invites artists working at the intersection of art, sustainability and community life to the Nicosia Monastery of Arts Residency in Nicosia, Cyprus.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Knight-Wallace Journalism Fellowships 2027-28 (University of Michigan) (closes 1 Dec)
item.description:
Wallace House Center for Journalists, University of Michigan
Deadline: 1 Dec 2026, 23:59 EST
Award: USD 85,000 stipend plus USD 5,000 relocation (figures from secondary listings; confirm on the official site).

An academic-year fellowship for mid-career journalists to pursue a study project at the University of Michigan, with seminars and programming at Wallace House. DEADLINES: international applicants 1 December 2026, 11:59 pm ET; US applicants 1 February 2027. No application fee stated.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Cove Park Awarded Residencies 2027-2028 (Scotland, UK, Central and South America and diasporas) (closes 11 Dec)
item.description:
Cove Park
Deadline: 11 Dec 2026, 17:00 GMT
Award: Fully funded: GBP 775 per week fee (VAT inclusive, freelance), travel allowance (Scotland GBP 65 to 200, rest of UK up to GBP 250, Europe up to GBP 400, other international up to GBP 1,250), materials up to GBP 150 for studio-based practitioners, private accommodation and studio, visa and access support. Application Access Bursary available (request by 30 November 2026). No application fee.

Cove Park's biennial call for fully funded Awarded Residencies at its 50-acre rural residency site in Argyll, on the west coast of Scotland, programmed between May 2027 and December 2028.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Follow Fluxus: After Fluxus Scholarship 2026/27 (EUR 10,000, 3-month studio and exhibition, Wiesbaden)
item.description: Nassauischer Kunstverein Wiesbaden, with the City of Wiesbaden · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · EUR 10,000 grant plus a rent-free 70.88 sqm live/work studio at the Kunsthaus Wiesbaden for three months and a follow-up exhibition at the Nassauischer Kunstverein. No application fee mentioned.

item.title: HIAP x Sumud: Residency for Palestinian Artists in Helsinki, Spring 2027 (EUR 3,600 working grant)
item.description: HIAP Helsinki International Artist Programme, with Sumud - The Finnish Palestine Network · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · EUR 3,600 working grant, a free 63 sqm live/work studio, one return trip, and a visa budget covering application fees and visa-office travel. No application fee.

item.title: TRACES Art & Science @ Energypolis 2027: residency at the EPFL Laboratory for Energy Materials (Sion)
item.description: Foundation for the Sustainable Development of Mountain Regions (FDDM) with EPFL Valais-Wallis · deadline 22 Nov 2026 · Artist stipend of CHF 2,000 per month (CHF 6,000 total) covering living and research costs, housing in Sion, travel from home and back up to CHF 1,500, and a separate production budget set by the curator. No application fee.

item.title: Jan van Eyck Academie Residency 2028 (Maastricht, 11 months)
item.description: Jan van Eyck Academie · deadline 01 Dec 2026 · Monthly stipend of EUR 1,500 (EUR 2,000 for participants with children; EUR 1,500 per duo member or EUR 2,500 combined for life partners; collectives up to EUR 4,500 combined, max three stipends), with rent including service costs deducted from the stipend. Plus a EUR 2,000 annual working budget and a newly built, furnished private studio apartment. Application fee EUR 65 excl. VAT (EUR 78.65 incl. VAT), waived for applicants from and living in OECD DAC-list countries; enrolment fee for accepted participants EUR 2,750 excl. VAT.

item.title: YAO Residency #02 (Taiwan): Research Residency 2027 and Exhibition 2028
item.description: YAO Residency Program (Yao Zuo Zhu Cun Ji Hua) · deadline 31 Dec 2026 · Research Residency 2027: travel support (international applicants reimbursed up to NTD 20,000 for one round-trip to Taiwan against receipts), production budget up to NTD 20,000, living stipend of NTD 10,000, accommodation, Open Studio venue, local connections, and documentation, text editing, translation and promotional support. Exhibition Phase 2028: travel support up to NTD 20,000 again, a further NTD 10,000 living stipend, accommodation, exhibition venue at YAO, installation and de-installation assistance, and exhibition documentation. Application fee: NTD 300 for Taiwan-based applicants (bank transfer) or USD 10 for international applicants (PayPal), non-refundable.

item.title: HIAP: Learning Materials International Artist Residency 2027 (Suomenlinna, Helsinki)
item.description: HIAP (Helsinki International Artist Programme), with Kone Foundation · deadline 26 Oct 2026 · Working grant of EUR 1,350 per month (EUR 4,050 total for 90 days) via Kone Foundation, material budget up to EUR 750, access budget up to EUR 1,000, one return trip covered (slow travel encouraged), plus accommodation and workspace. For collectives, the working grant can be paid to one individual only and there is no additional travel budget.

item.title: Invisible Cartographies: Residency for Neurodivergent Artists (Buinho, Portugal)
item.description: Buinho Creative Hub (Creative Europe project Invisible Cartographies) · deadline 26 Oct 2026 · EUR 1,200 artist fee for the six weeks, free accommodation for the full period, travel budget up to EUR 300, plus a production budget and FabLab access. Meals not included. No application fee.

item.title: OASis Bom Dia Residency 2027 at Cultivamos Cultura (Sao Luis, Portugal)
item.description: Cultivamos Cultura (European OASis project) · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · EUR 1,300 project fee, travel budget up to EUR 500, production and material expenses up to EUR 1,600 (pre-approved), food per diem, plus free accommodation in a private room in a shared farmhouse and access to a workspace or studio and all Cultivamos Cultura spaces and resources.
